Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL3885882. Join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Filter for exact measurements where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
